svg.aria-label: easyPID 1.1.0, my PID controller library on the Arduino Library Manager. My PID controller library for Arduino, for any board. Each controller is its own instance, with anti-windup, derivative filtering and an optional relay autotuner. On the scope: its own update step steering a simulated motor, with anti-windup on, and off (faint).
